audit.why: Ranged poke vs. a point-and-click root engage tank with no dash-closer of his own until W — Favoured/4/10 matches a lane Vel'Koz controls by spacing around Twisted Advance's cooldown.
Level 2 zone, level 6 out-range on R, first-item two-shot on a squishy-for-a-tank ADC are the real spikes and already stated correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0] ('E the engage mid-charge') tells you to punish Twisted Advance while it's happening, but the ability flags untargetable during the dash — an E thrown mid-charge whiffs, per missingInteractions rule untargetable-dodges-burst.
audit.why: enemyKit.W flags untargetable: 'dodges timed burst and executes'. Advising a cast into that window is the opposite of correct play.
audit.corrected: Wait for him to land and root before punishing — spend nothing while he's still untargetable mid-dash.

edits.after: Wait for the landing, then E

edits.before: Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: He's untargetable mid-dash, so punishing the charge whiffs your E — land it right as he stops to root, not before.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Once Twisted Advance lands on someone, full-rotate — Q, W and E all connect on a rooted target for the true-damage proc.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp (R) walls off your retreat and you have no dash of your own — bank Flash for the wall, not the poke.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. It writes your spacing rules. - E Tectonic Disruption is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
